_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for scholarly metadata used by the /cite/ page, bibliography files, page <meta>/JSON-LD and CITATION.cff. Edit this file by hand; the generator (build_cite.py) only reads it. A value of null means 'not verified / does not exist yet' and is never replaced by a guess. Never put a placeholder DOI or ORCID here.
